Primary request: design a completely new polished icon from the ground up, using image 1 only for the real vessel's anatomy and image 2 only for the established app style. Do not reuse the previous generated icon shapes. Style: rounded filled monochrome forms like the Coffee / Water / In cup symbols in image 2, natural simple vessel silhouette, gently organic curvature and a slight view from above to show the mouth. Uniform charcoal fill on genuinely transparent background. Preserve a believable physical vessel; do not exaggerate height, squash the cup or distort it to force uniqueness. Clarity comes from its real shape and hardware. Show a filled body with a small clear mouth/rim opening and clean open handle where present. Details and negative spaces must remain readable at 24-34 pixels. Smooth clean contour, 2-5 purposeful shape regions, no thin wireframe outline, no unnecessary geometric slots, no shading, gradients, texture, highlights in another color, text, logo, steam, liquid stripes, cast shadow or background. Center one single complete icon with consistent comfortable framing, occupying about 75% of the square canvas. Native reference colors are not the requested output color. Vessel: A real small ceramic espresso demitasse: softly rounded compact body, slight taper, small curved handle. Keep the warm natural cup proportions of the anatomy reference; no saucer and no miniature tall mug.
